notes.subject: imperative verbs
notes.rationale: Direct address — imperatives to the personified town (Zion) to shave her head in mourning.

notes.subject: קרחי / קרחתך
notes.rationale: Verb 'make bald' and noun 'your baldness' share the root קרח, repetition heightening the mourning gesture.

notes.subject: קרחי וגזי
notes.rationale: Shaving the head is the Hebrew mourning rite, rendered literally; Tok Pisin readers may miss the funerary custom.

translation: Katim hea bilong yu na save gut, long ol pikinini bilong switpela laip bilong yu; mekim olgeta narapela sain bilong pen long kalabos — olsem tarangau i go long ples bilong kalabos, long wanem ol i go ausait long yu.
